Class SimpleContext.ConsentBuilder

java.lang.Object
dev.faststats.SimpleContext.Builder
dev.faststats.SimpleContext.ConsentBuilder
All Implemented Interfaces:
FastStatsContext.Builder, FastStatsContext.ConsentBuilder
Enclosing class:
SimpleContext
public static final class SimpleContext.ConsentBuilder extends SimpleContext.Builder implements FastStatsContext.ConsentBuilder
Builder for SimpleContext on platforms that can ask the user for consent.

Platforms read isConsentRequired() from their build hook, as the user may require consent after the platform configured the builder.

Since:
0.33.0

    • requireConsent

      @Contract(value=" -> this", mutates="this") public SimpleContext.ConsentBuilder requireConsent()
      Description copied from interface: FastStatsContext.ConsentBuilder
      Requires the user to explicitly give consent before anything is submitted.

      When at least one project requires consent, the consent screen is shown until it was shown once, nothing is submitted before that. Platforms without a consent screen, such as dedicated servers, ignore this setting.

      Specified by:
      requireConsent in interface FastStatsContext.ConsentBuilder
      Returns:
      this builder

    • token

      public SimpleContext.ConsentBuilder token(@Nullable String token)
      Description copied from interface: FastStatsContext.Builder
      Sets the FastStats project token.

      If no token is set, the token injected at build time is read, if a token resource was configured. Without any token, the created context is disabled.

      Specified by:

    • onBuild

      public SimpleContext.ConsentBuilder onBuild(BiConsumer<SimpleContext, SimpleContext.Builder> hook)
      Description copied from class: SimpleContext.Builder
      Adds a hook that runs right after the context was built, before SimpleContext.Builder.build() returns it.

      Platforms use this to wire the context into their lifecycle, for example to make it ready once the server started. Failures are not caught and abort the build.

      Unlike the other hooks, this hook is only available to platforms, as it is not part of FastStatsContext.Builder.

      Overrides:
      onBuild in class SimpleContext.Builder
      Parameters:
      hook - the hook, receiving the context and this builder
      Returns:
      this builder

    • onReady

      public SimpleContext.ConsentBuilder onReady(Consumer<FastStatsContext> hook)
      Description copied from interface: FastStatsContext.Builder
      Adds a hook that runs once when the context becomes ready.

      If a hook fails, the context stays not ready and all hooks run again on the next call, so hooks must be safe to run more than once.

      Specified by:

    • service

      public SimpleContext.ConsentBuilder service(Function<SimpleContext, ? extends FastStatsService> service)
      Description copied from interface: FastStatsContext.Builder
      Adds an optional service to the context.

      The factory receives the created context, so the service can use its logger, configuration, scheduler and submission helpers. Services are started before the metrics submission task and shut down before the metrics are flushed.
